# The idea

Atomicity is a *size* claim and an *ownership* claim: one idea, and our own
words (or the agent's distilled words), never a dump of source material.
Source dumps belong to [Literature Notes](../literature/zettel-de-introduction.md).

# Why it matters here

Useful structure emerges from many small, densely linked notes —
[Shape of my vault](../structure.md) — not from well-organized big documents.
